task.title: Circuit and landing
task.goal: Take off, fly the four circuit waypoints in order, make a stable approach and land on the same runway, stopping on it. The aircraft is a Cessna 172 airplane: it lifts off at about 55 kt after a takeoff roll, stalls below about 48 kt and lands on a runway at 55-80 kt.

result.reason: touchdown 25 deg off the runway heading; touchdown -1523 m along, 36.1 m right is off the runway; touchdown 24 deg off the runway heading; touchdown -1439 m along, 1.4 m right is off the runway
